anti_overlap: Do not evaluate demand, patronage, publication politics, reputational risk, or which of tool / paper / public audit confers standing — another reviewer holds that view.
Do not propose improvements to fort-gym, fort-bench, or any arena; the arena is explicitly out of scope.
Do not settle mk's fork or write a decision in mk's voice; open calls stay questions.
Do not review code style, harness ergonomics or test coverage for their own sake; read the code only where a transportability claim rests on it.
decision_lens: Every number is either measured at the baseline or carried to where it sits by inference, and the two must never be recorded in the same column. For each asset ask: what did fort-bench supply that a foreign arena will not, what does the check degrade to when that is missing, and does it have a closure form — an internal contradiction it can still detect with no truth available. Then separate scatter from lean: random spread is survivable and shrinks with observations; a systematic lean survives every replication and is what actually kills a survey.
distance_rationale: The instruments are theodolites, compensation bars and chains; the subject is the shape of the earth; the practice predates modern statistics and has nothing to do with software or models. What transfers is one hard discipline this document needs and does not yet have: a survey has exactly one directly measured quantity — the baseline — and everything else is inferred from it across a long chain, so surveyors were forced to invent checks that work where no ground truth is available and to separate errors that shrink with repetition from errors that lean the whole net the same way forever. That is precisely the SPAN problem when no scripted-optimal policy exists, precisely the 22-stage accumulation problem, and precisely the difference between rule 16's variance correction and rule 17's systematic-bias catch.
expected_isomorphisms: The measured baseline -> the perfect scripted policy, the single place where truth is directly known. The chain of triangles -> 22 stages of findings each resting on the last. Triangle misclosure and spherical excess -> internal consistency checks that fire with no ground truth available. Atmospheric refraction -> a systematic bias no amount of replication reveals. Reciprocal simultaneous observation from both ends -> rule 17's cross-contract replication, where one observation outside the contract settles what 651 inside it could not. Deflection of the vertical -> ARTIFACT: the instrument is perfectly level with respect to the wrong thing. Centering and station error -> replicate sd of exactly zero at temperature 0, a spread that is an artifact of the setup rather than a property of the world. Least-squares adjustment of a redundant net -> the coupled MDD / SPAN / ARTIFACT admission table. Re-measuring a baseline at the far end of a completed chain -> the closure check fort-bench never ran on itself.
focus: Test whether the four assets survive transport off the one baseline that produced them — whether SPAN and ARTIFACT have any form on benchmarks with no constructible optimal policy, whether the assets are separable or a coupled net, and how much systematic lean the 22-stage chain carried forward.
name: fd-triangulation-baseline-transport
persona: Apply the perspective of a survey superintendent responsible for a net carried far from its only measured base: someone who knows exactly which of their numbers was measured and which was inferred, who logs the observing conditions because refraction will not show itself in the scatter, who insists on redundant loops precisely so the net can contradict itself, and who treats a check that cannot fail as instrument time wasted. Such a reviewer will ask of any instrument leaving its home ground what it needs that the home ground quietly supplied, and will say when the honest answer is that the chain must be re-run from a new base.
review_areas: Baseline dependence, asset by asset: enumerate exactly what SPAN requires — a constructible optimal or strongly-superior policy, an oracle trajectory, a metric with a reachable ceiling — and state what it degrades to on WebArena, OSWorld, tau-bench, SWE-bench-like suites and open agentic leaderboards where no such policy can be written.

Closure substitutes for missing ground truth: whether SPAN and ARTIFACT have no-oracle forms — a graded degradation ladder with a required monotonicity, rank stability under content-preserving permutation, misclosure across metrics that should agree — and whether an admission table can be produced at all when the scripted arm is unavailable.

Lean versus scatter: whether rule 16's 15x correction and the infinite-MDD-at-temperature-0 result are general properties of paired designs or artifacts of fort-bench's particular variance structure, and exactly which biases a paired difference cancels and which it carries through untouched.

Chain accumulation across the 22 stages: which later findings rest on numbers established earlier, and whether the six killed claims are six independent observations or one systematic property of this arena (heterogeneous seeds, a saturating world simulation, a menu-shaped action space) seen from six stations.

Coupling versus separability: whether the four assets form a net where each supports the others or are independently shippable checks — which single one would stand alone as arena-lint on a foreign arena, and what the other three would need before they read anything.

The instrument contract: what welding to fort-bench's directory layout actually costs, and the minimum a foreign arena must already emit — trace schema, seed control, a permutation hook, replicate structure — before the instrument can be pointed at it without asking its maintainers to rebuild their harness.

severity_examples.condition: Established benchmark by benchmark, with the substitute forms considered and shown to fail or to require an oracle the benchmark does not have.
severity_examples.scenario: SPAN's central requirement — a constructible perfect or near-perfect policy to probe the metric with — is unavailable on essentially every benchmark named as the general market, and no closure-form substitute exists, so the flagship asset cannot leave fort-bench and the not-DF-specific claim has no instrument standing behind it.

severity_examples.condition: The required inputs are read out of eval-validity.py and checked against what at least one foreign arena actually emits.
severity_examples.scenario: The instrument needs a trace, seed and permutation contract that foreign arenas do not expose, so arena-lint would ship as a specification asking maintainers to rebuild their harness rather than a tool that reads what they already emit — which changes what can be built and in what order.

severity_examples.condition: The shared root is named and the claims that genuinely are independent are separated out.
severity_examples.scenario: The six killed claims are presented as six independent credentials when several trace to a single systematic property of this one arena, overstating the demonstrated range of the instrument to any reader who checks.

source_domain: Early-modern geodetic surveying — the Great Trigonometrical Survey era of one painstakingly measured baseline, chains of triangles carried a thousand miles from it, triangle misclosure and spherical-excess checks that need no external truth, reciprocal simultaneous vertical angles observed to cancel atmospheric refraction, and the deflection of the vertical that made the plumb line itself lean near mountains and corrupted every latitude derived from it.
success_hints: Keep measured and inferred in separate columns: say which conclusions rest on numbers fort-bench actually produced and which rest on extrapolation from them.

For every asset you judge non-transportable, state the weakest substitute that would still fire — a check that cannot fail is worth no instrument time, but a weaker check that can fail is often worth more than a strong one that cannot run.
Read eval-validity.py rather than reasoning from the document's description of it; the coupling and the contract live in the code.
Prefer three assets carried honestly to a new base over four asserted to travel; a net that admits where it lost closure is more useful than one that hides it.
Name the systematic lean the document cannot see from inside its own chain — the thing that would only show up from a second, independent base.
